parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- zh: Chinese
- en: English.

parameters.name: ChargeType
parameters.description:
The billing method. Valid values: PREPAY (subscription) and POSTPAY (pay-as-you-go).

This parameter is ignored for the Serverless Edition.

parameters.name: ClusterSpecification
parameters.description: The engine specifications. Valid values:

parameters.name: ClusterType
parameters.description: The cluster type, such as ZooKeeper or Nacos-Ans.

parameters.name: ClusterVersion
parameters.description: The cluster version. Valid values:

parameters.name: ConnectionType
parameters.description: The network access type. Valid values: `slb` and `single_eni`. In some regions, the Developer Edition supports only the `single_eni` type.

parameters.name: DiskType
parameters.description: No longer used.

parameters.name: EipEnabled
parameters.description: Valid when ConnectionType is set to `single_eni`. Specifies whether to enable public network access by using an elastic IP address (EIP).

parameters.name: InstanceCount
parameters.description:
The number of instance nodes. Valid values: 1 to 9.
[Professional Edition] 

-  `NACOS_2_0_0`: Nacos 2.x.x.
- `ZooKeeper_3_8_0`: ZooKeeper 3.8.x.
[Developer Edition] 

-  `NACOS_2_0_0`: Nacos 2.x.
- `ZooKeeper_3_8_0`: ZooKeeper 3.8.x.
[Serverless Edition]

-  `NACOS_2_0_0`: Nacos 2.x.
- `ZooKeeper_3_8_0`: ZooKeeper 3.8.x.

parameters.name: InstanceName
parameters.description: The custom name of the instance.

parameters.name: MseVersion
parameters.description:
Required in most cases. Valid values:

- `mse_pro`: Professional Edition.
- `mse_dev`: Developer Edition.
- `mse_serverless`: Serverless Edition.

parameters.name: NetType
parameters.description:
The network type. Valid values:
- `privatenet`: virtual private cloud (VPC).
- `pubnet`: Internet.

parameters.name: PrivateSlbSpecification
parameters.description: No longer used.

parameters.name: PubNetworkFlow
parameters.description:
Valid when ConnectionType is set to `slb`. A value of 0 indicates that no Internet-facing SLB instance is created. A value of 1 or greater specifies the fixed bandwidth of the Internet-facing SLB instance, in Mbit/s.

Valid values: 0 to 5000.

parameters.name: PubSlbSpecification
parameters.description: No longer used.

parameters.name: Region
parameters.description:
The region where the cluster resides. Valid values include but are not limited to:
- `ap-southeast-1`: Singapore
- `cn-beijing`: Beijing
- `cn-shanghai`: Shanghai
- `cn-zhangjiakou`: Zhangjiakou
- `cn-shenzhen`: Shenzhen.

parameters.name: RequestPars
parameters.description: The extended request parameters in JSON format.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The resource group ID. For more information about resource groups, see [View basic information of a resource group](~~457230~~).

parameters.name: SecurityGroupType
parameters.description: Valid when ConnectionType is set to `single_eni`. Specifies the type of the security group to which the instance belongs.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The list of tags to add. A maximum of 20 tags can be specified.

parameters.name: VSwitchId
parameters.description: The vSwitch ID.

parameters.name: VpcId
parameters.description: VPC ID。
